{{Quote|Droids from the ship have engineered a zone of extreme heat for creatures and plants that favor this environment. This area of the crash site-perhaps the most dangerous of them all-is wreaking catastrophic damage to the environment and its native flora and fauna.|From "[[Initial observations of the Jannimak crash site on Dantooine]]", by [[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]], Disaster Response Lead for the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]|<ref name="Codex" />}}
"'''Geothermal Disruption'''"<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|datapad "Personal Research Journal Entry: 044" located in the Geothermal Disruption forward camp}}</ref> was an area designated by the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], located in the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> To create a suitable environment for the thermophilic life forms aboard the ship, the ship's droids executed a rapid excavation on a massive scale in that area, drilling to extreme depths, tapping into naturally-occurring [[Magma/Legends|magma]] flows, and drawing them to the surface. Droid's hastily-constructed drilling equipment was generating toxic runoff damaging the environment even further.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Geothermal Disruption}}</ref> The changed environmental conditions however, proved beneficial for a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ancient Dantooinian fungi]], preservation of which became one of the scientific goals for [[Kontor|Doctor Kontor]],<ref name="Fungal Protection">{{TORcite|Fungal Protection|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> a [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] scientist whose main research on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was occurring in the [[Glacial Trespass]].<ref name="location" />

== GSI efforts ==
The research team stationed in Geothermal Disruption was led by [[Cavalz|Professor Cavalz]], [[Naul|Professor Naul]], [[Gentra|Doctor Gentra]] and one coral-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek geothermal researcher|researcher]].<ref name="location" /> From their forward camp, the scientists were contacting [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors, tasking them with hazardous missions - mainly taking readings and tempering with [[Jannimak]]'s equipment to stop the poisonous runoff of toxic gases<ref name="Vent Sync Failure">{{TORcite|Vent Sync Failure|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> and acid leaks.<ref name="Caustic Cascade">{{TORcite|Caustic Cascade|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>  While exploring the area, [[Cavalz]]'s team stumbled upon a lone [[Graul/Legends|graul]], whom GSI contractors had to defend against the ship's droids.<ref name="Graul Graveyard" />
[[File:LavaCaveGeothermal-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|An underground [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] cave overflown with lava because of the [[Jannimak]]'s droids' excavation]]
An underground cave area of the Geothermal Disruption, overflown with lava, became home for [[Geo Beast|Geo beasts]]<ref name="Fungal Protection" /> and [[Embercrawler|embercrawlers]] from [[Jannimak]]. Extremely high temperatures overheated the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] growing in the caves, which became one of the focuses of the study.<ref name="Thermal Investigation">{{TORcite|Thermal Investigation|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> 

=== Czerka ===
Aside from the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], another organization that showed its interest in the phenomena occurring in the Glacial Trespass was [[Czerka Arms|Czerka]]. Czerka's heavy-shielded personnel and mining droids infiltrated the adjacent to the Geothermal Disruption wing of the crashed [[Jannimak]] and attempted to steal the GSI's research data but GSI's contractors stopped them.<ref name="Data Appropriation">{{TORcite|Data Appropriation|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Geothermal Disruption first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> On the map, Geothermal Disruption area is marked by [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Aurek/Legends|Aurek]].<ref name="lots">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

One of the scientists stationed at the Geothermal Disruption forward camp, not given a name in game, uses the same character model as that of [[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]]. Since he is unnamed, it is not possible to designate him as the same person or a striking lookalike in the same clothes.<ref name="location" />
